summary: LIDDIA is an autonomous agent designed to navigate the drug discovery process in silico by leveraging large language models and state-of-the-art computational tools. It integrates four components: REASONER for planning actions, EXECUTOR for executing drug discovery tasks, EVALUATOR for assessing molecule properties, and MEMORY for storing information. LIDDIA generates novel, diverse, and high-quality molecules meeting key pharmaceutical criteria across 30 clinically relevant targets, achieving a 73.3% target success rate. It balances exploration and exploitation in chemical space, iteratively generating, optimizing, and screening molecules. Compared to existing methods and general-purpose LLMs, LIDDIA outperforms in producing molecules with better drug-likeness, binding affinity,synthetic-accessibility,novelty,anddiversity.Itsmodulararchitectureallowsintegrationofnewtoolsandproperties.ItidentifiespromisingcandidatesforcriticaltargetslikeAR/NR3C4andEGFR,showingpotentialforcancertherapies.Limitationsincludein-silico-onlyevaluation,limitedpropertycoverage,andneedforwet-labvalidation.Humanexpertiseremainsessentialforpracticaldeployment.Codeanddatasetarepubliclyavailable.
title: LIDDIA: Language-based Intelligent Drug Discovery Agent
